description: This Java class implements a rule engine node for handling device state events such as connect, disconnect, activity, and inactivity within the Thingsboard platform. It manages rate limiting per device and triggers device state changes accordingly.

classes.name: TbDeviceStateNode
classes.description: Implements a rule engine node for managing device connectivity events with rate limiting and event triggering.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, setting up event type and rate limits based on configuration.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, filters for device originator, applies rate limiting, and triggers device state events.

methods.name: sendEventAndTell
methods.description: Sends the appropriate device state event to the DeviceStateManager based on the configured event type.

methods.name: getMsgEnqueuedCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback to handle success or failure of message enqueue operations.

methods.name: onPartitionChangeMsg
methods.description: Handles partition change messages, cleaning up rate limits for non-local entities.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the node is destroyed.
